title: August and the Debt
author: Lena Oyelaran
blurb: Vesper Thackeray, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
